title: Corroded Sub
description: A low sawtooth 808/sub bass driven by a ladder filter envelope, slowly corroding as crush and coarse downsampling ramp up across the loop. Pitch-envelope knocks, squiz mangling and occasional reversed hits give it a broken, alien transmission character.
code:
setcpm(116/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 [eb1 c1] g0>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .penv("<0 12 -7 5>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.07)
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(120, 1600)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(16).range(1.5, 4.5)).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.18)
    .crush(saw.slow(16).range(16, 4))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 4 8>/8")
    .squiz("<0 0 1 2>/4")
    .shape(sine.slow(13).range(0.2, 0.55))
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.22).sustain(0.45).release(0.07)
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(0.1)).gain(0.3).pan(0.75))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .room(0.2).delay("0.3:0.5:0.6").gain(0.9)
)
